def test_user_registration_and_login():
    username = f"user_{generate_random_string()}"
    password = "password123"
    email = f"{username}@example.com"

    reg_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": email,
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=reg_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=reg_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

name: User Address And Card Management

def test_user_address_and_card_management():
    username = f"user_{generate_random_string()}"
    password = "password123"

    reg_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=reg_payload, timeout=10)

    addr_payload = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
        "street": "Downing Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert addr_id is not None, "Expected address id in response"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{addr_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr_data = resp.json()
    assert addr_data.get("city") == "London"
    assert addr_data.get("id") == addr_id

    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert card_id is not None, "Expected card id in response"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_data = resp.json()
    assert card_data.get("id") == card_id
    assert card_data.get("longNum") == "************3456"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    embedded_addrs = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert any(a.get("id") == addr_id for a in embedded_addrs)

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{addr_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    embedded_addrs = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert not any(a.get("id") == addr_id for a in embedded_addrs)

def test_carts_management():
    customer_id = f"cust_{generate_random_string()}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    socks = resp.json()
    item_id = socks[0]["id"]

    item_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": 10.5
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    item_payload["quantity"] = 5
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 5

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == item_id

def test_orders_creation_workflow():
    username = f"user_{generate_random_string()}"

    reg_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password123",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=reg_payload, timeout=10)

    addr_payload = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
        "street": "Downing Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_payload, timeout=10)
    addr_id = resp.json().get("id")

    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    item_id = resp.json()[0]["id"]

    item_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": 15.0
    }
    requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)

    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{addr_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    assert "id" in order
    order_id = order["id"]
    assert order["customer"]["username"] == username
    assert order["address"]["city"] == "London"
    assert order["card"]["longNum"] == "************3456"
    assert len(order["items"]) == 1
    assert order["items"][0]["itemId"] == item_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["id"] == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer_orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o["id"] == order_id for o in customer_orders)
